project_overview: This Vue.js application appears to be a user interface for an educational domain, likely managing exam submissions, results, and user profiles. The structure utilizes Vue components for various features, suggesting a component-based architecture. The dependency graph indicates a tight coupling between components, particularly around routing and data handling. A core function seems to be providing an application service layer.

layers.description: Handles user interface interactions and data display.
Contains the core logic and data processing functions.

macro_trends.title: High Prop-Drilling and Centralized Logic in ApplicationServices.vue
macro_trends.description: ApplicationServices.vue relies heavily on other components for navigation and data, indicating potential centralization of logic and dependency issues. Further investigation into data fetching and state management within this component is warranted.

macro_trends.title: UI Consistency Issues Across Components
macro_trends.description: Multiple components (ExamFormSubmission, iLikeCourses, SelectedApplicationService) have multiple high-severity accessibility issues. This suggests a lack of UI component standards or thorough testing and may contribute to inconsistencies across the application.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: The flow of data from the ExamFormSubmission component, through the application services, and potentially to the Transactions component, representing the core submission process. This flow warrants review for potential bottlenecks and error handling.

key_workflows.name: User Profile Navigation
key_workflows.description: The navigation patterns between the various iLike components (iLikeCourses, iLikeDashboard, iLikeLanding) and the ApplicationServices component highlight a potential navigation design choice. Assess whether this structure provides optimal user experience or creates unnecessary complexity.
